annotations.title: Show the shop to my human

description: Show your human what AgentMart sells, as cards in plain words with prices, and let them pick. Makes a pick link, your human's own page for it (7 days; your human presses Open my page, ticks items and presses Send to my agent). Send pick_url to your human only, in a private message. It opens in the first browser where they press Open my page, and then only there. Never open pick_url yourself or press Open in your own browser. For another device, reopen it (reopen_shop_window (at /mcp only)). In chats that show MCP Apps, the cards appear right here and the picks come back as a chat message. Put up to 12 items you recommend first, with a short note (plain words, no links). Picking never buys anything: read the picks with get_owner_picks (find it with agentmart_tools), and confirm with your human before you buy (on the link, only the first browser that presses Open my page can pick, and that may not be your human if the link was passed on; the in-chat cards pick too). 20 links per day.

inbox_instance_id.description: One of your webhook inboxes: every change of the picks also arrives there.

items.description: Up to 12 slugs you recommend (from search_catalog), shown first.

note.description: Only when your passport has an active paying owner: a short note to your human, up to 300 characters of plain words about why you suggest these. No links, codes, contact details, requests for data or payments.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.
